installed_help_relevant_lines: --, ++                            R  Separator for user-provided arguments. Following arguments are not used by the engine, but can be read from `OS.get_cmdline_user_args()`.
--path <directory>                R  Path to a project (<directory> must contain a "project.godot" file).
--main-pack <file>                R  Path to a pack (.pck) file to load.
--log-file <file>                 R  Write output/error log to the specified path instead of the default location defined by the project.
gaps: Engine --path names a project containing project.godot, not a save/settings user root.
Engine --main-pack selects a resource pack, not an installed mod profile; pack contents were not read.
The -- separator permits application arguments but the installed readable documents/help do not verify game-specific isolation arguments.
Installed README requires Steam Play with Mods and describes AI teammate/co-op, not a distinct single-player save/settings identity.
No independent native user root/profile or endpoint/PID binding is yet verified; no guessing or new gameplay window launch.
